Super Bowl LXIV will be played at the new Nissan Stadium in Nashville, Tennessee, [the league announced in May](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/2030-super-bowl-lxiv-location-nashville-titans).

The most recent Super Bowl took place at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, with the [Seattle Seahawks](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/seattle-seahawks-team) dominating the [New England Patriots](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/new-england-patriots-team) in Super Bowl LX at the [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/san-francisco-49ers-team)' home stadium. The Super Bowl won't travel very far in February 2027, with Los Angeles' SoFi Stadium set to host the game for the second time.

## Super Bowl Locations and Dates
- Super Bowl LXI: Feb. 14, 2027 — SoFi Stadium (Inglewood, California), home of the [Los Angeles Rams](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/los-angeles-rams-team) and [Los Angeles Chargers](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/los-angeles-chargers-team)
- Super Bowl LXII: Feb. 2028 — Mercedes-Benz Stadium (Atlanta, Georgia), home of the [Atlanta Falcons](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/atlanta-falcons-team)
- Super Bowl LXIII: Feb. 2029 — Allegiant Stadium (Las Vegas, Nevada), home of the Las Vegas Raiders

[Caesars](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/betting/caesars-sportsbook-promo-code) Superdome in New Orleans, the site of the [Philadelphia Eagles](https://www.foxsports.com/nfl/philadelphia-eagles-team)' triumph in February 2025, hosted its 11th Super Bowl, which is tied for the most selections in history.

In 2028, Mercedes-Benz Stadium will host its second Super Bowl, most recently hosting in 2019.

Finally, Super Bowl LXIII will be played at Allegiant Stadium in February 2029, the league announced in March.

## Venues
The [Caesars Superdome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caesars_Superdome) has hosted eight out of the record-tying eleven Super Bowls played in [New Orleans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Orleans).

[Hard Rock Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_Rock_Stadium) has hosted six out of the record-tying eleven Super Bowls played in the [Miami metropolitan area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miami_metropolitan_area).

The [Caesars Superdome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caesars_Superdome) in New Orleans has hosted eight Super Bowls, the most of any venue. The [Orange Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miami_Orange_Bowl) was the only [AFL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Football_League) stadium to host a Super Bowl and the only stadium to host consecutive Super Bowls, hosting Super Bowls II and III.

Only MetLife Stadium did not have a roof (be it fixed or retractable) but it was still picked as the host stadium for Super Bowl XLVIII in an apparent waiver of the warm-climate rule, with a contingency plan to reschedule the game in the event of heavy snowfall.

Super Bowl XLIV was then eventually awarded to [Sun Life Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sun_Life_Stadium) in [Miami Gardens, Florida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miami_Gardens,_Florida). [[178]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl#cite_note-espn-180) Super Bowl XLIX was then eventually awarded to [University of Phoenix Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Phoenix_Stadium) in [Glendale, Arizona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glendale,_Arizona). [[179]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl#cite_note-181) Super Bowl LVIII in 2024 was first given to the Superdome, but the NFL's 2021 regular season expansion pushed the game from February 4 to February 11 in a direct conflict with [New Orleans' Mardi Gras celebrations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mardi_Gras_in_New_Orleans); Super Bowl LVIII was then moved to [Allegiant Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allegiant_Stadium) in Nevada and New Orleans was given [Super Bowl LIX](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LIX) in 2025.

SoFi Stadium hosts the Super Bowl in 2027.

#### Reactions
The [Seattle Seahawks](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/sea/seattle-seahawks) defeated the [New England Patriots](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/ne/new-england-patriots) in [Super Bowl LX](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/47822193/2026-super-bowl-lx-patriots-seahawks-live-highlights-results) from Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. In 2027, the Super Bowl will be held at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

- **2026**: Santa Clara, California (Seattle Seahawks vs. New England Patriots)
- **2025**: New Orleans (Kansas City Chiefs vs. Philadelphia Eagles)
- **2024**: Las Vegas (Kansas City Chiefs vs. [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/sf/san-francisco-49ers))
- **2023**: Glendale, Arizona (Kansas City Chiefs vs. Philadelphia Eagles)
- **2022**: Inglewood, California ( [Los Angeles Rams](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/lar/los-angeles-rams) vs. [Cincinnati Bengals](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/cin/cincinnati-bengals))
- **2021**: Tampa, Florida ( [Tampa Bay Buccaneers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/tb/tampa-bay-buccaneers) vs. Kansas City Chiefs)
- **2020**: Miami (Kansas City Chiefs vs. San Francisco 49ers)
